    Nutritional Information & Allergens

    ALLERGEN & DIETARY INFORMATION

    Domino’s takes food allergies seriously. However, our stores handle a wide range of ingredients, and multiple allergens are present in the store environment.

    Due to shared preparation areas, equipment and normal store operations, cross-contact may occur. This may result in the presence of unintentional traces of allergens, including gluten, animal products and/or meat.

    As a result, we cannot guarantee that any product is completely gluten free, allergen free, or strictly vegan or vegetarian.

    Customers with allergies or specific dietary requirements should review the latest allergen information online before placing an order.

    Major allergens present in store may include:
    gluten-containing cereals (including wheat, barley, rye, oats); tree nuts (pistachio, almond, hazelnut, Brazil nut, cashew, macadamia, pecan, pine nut, walnut); soy; milk; eggs; sesame; crustacea; fish; molluscs; peanuts; sulphites; lupin; and other allergens.

    Nutrition information is based on standard product formulations, recipes, and serving sizes. Values are derived from supplier information, food composition databases, published resources, and/or laboratory analysis. Actual nutritional values may vary due to differences in ingredient sourcing, seasonal availability, processing and preparation methods, portion sizes, product customisation, supplier changes, and product reformulation. Nutrient values calculated from food composition data are estimates only and may not fully reflect the nutrient content of the final product. This information is provided as a guide only and should not be relied upon as medical, dietary, or nutritional advice.

Minimum delivery order value varies by store, and does not exceed $22.90 including surcharges. Drivers only carry $20 in change. All offers not valid with any other coupon or offer unless otherwise stated. Offers available in selected stores.
    Selected Western Australia and Tasmania stores only: Delivery costs $5.95 per order, plus extended delivery fee, if applicable. Extended delivery fee varies by applicable store, and ranges from $1.99 to $9.99. Sunday, public holiday and late night surcharges, if applicable, are calculated on total order value, excluding delivery fees. Further information on participating Western Australia and Tasmania stores available online.

    *Skip the Queue priority order service available for online orders only. Skip the Queue not available for pre-timed orders or UberEats, Menulog or DoorDash orders. $4 service fee applies to Skip the Queue delivery orders and $3 service fee applies to Skip the Queue pick up orders (subject to change).

    ^Kilojoule (KJ) values are based on a Large Classic Crust Pizza. The average adult daily energy intake is 8700kJ.

    *The displayed prices are local prices at your selected store only. Customisation may incur additional charges. A $2 Half ’n’ Half surcharge applies to Large Pizzas; not available for Vegan Cheese, Gluten Free, or Mix 'N' Match Box pizzas. Extra charges on Large Pizzas: $3 for Vegan Cheese, , $3.60 for Gluten Free Sourdough Crust, $3.50 for Cheesy Crust, $4 for Garlic Cheesy Crust; Premium Pizzas are $3 more than Traditional when using a Traditional Pizza voucher. Upgrade a Large to Family Size for $4 extra. Family available on Classic Crusts only. Family pizzas are 50% bigger in surface size post-bake, and have 50% more toppings, than Large Pizzas. Cheesy Crust,  Garlic Cheesy Crust and Gluten Free Sourdough Crust available on Large Pizzas only. No indulgent crusts allowed on Vegan Cheese Pizzas. Substitute toppings may not be allowed on Promotional Pizzas. Mini Pizzas in Mix 'N' Match Box are not customisable, vegan pizzas are not available.

    ALLERGEN & DIETARY INFORMATION

    Domino’s takes food allergies seriously. However, our stores handle a wide range of ingredients, and multiple allergens are present in the store environment.

    Due to shared preparation areas, equipment and normal store operations, cross-contact may occur, this may result in the presence of unintentional traces of allergens, gluten, animal products and / or meat.

    As a result, we cannot guarantee that any product is completely gluten free or allergen free.

    More details about Domino’s vegan, vegetarian, allergen and gluten-free products are available online and can be accessed by scanning the allergen brochure and QR code in store.

    Customers with allergies or specific dietary requirements should review the latest allergen information online before placing an order.

    Major Allergens Present in Store Include: Wheat, Tree nuts (pistachio, almond, hazelnut, Brazil nut, cashew, macadamia, pecan, pine nut, walnut), Soy, Milk, Eggs, Sesame, Crustacea, Fish, Molluscs, Peanuts, Sulphites and Lupin, and other allergens.

    Customers can also contact the Domino’s Vocal Team AU for further information: Contact Us - Domino's Pizza Australia

    VEGETARIAN AND VEGAN PRODUCTS

    Our vegan and vegetarian menu items are designed for customers who choose these options for ethical or lifestyle reasons. However, they may not be suitable for individuals with food allergies.

    Domino’s stores will take all reasonable care to prepare vegan and vegetarian products when requested. However, traces of meat and/or dairy products may be unintentionally present due to cross‑contact during normal store operations. As a result, we cannot guarantee that vegan or vegetarian products will be completely free from animal‑derived ingredients.

    More details about Domino’s vegan, vegetarian, allergen and gluten‑free products are available online and can be accessed by scanning the allergen brochure and QR code in store. Customers can also contact the Domino’s Vocal Team AU for further information: Contact Us - Domino's Pizza Australia
